physical_profile.instance_maxima_scope: Independent maxima from unmatched algorithms/control histories, not an intrinsic T2/T6 comparison.

experiments.name: uniform-options
experiments.reason: Uniform scope restores primitive inlining; 4096-frame matched full ISR improves.

experiments.name: uniform-unswitch
experiments.reason: Remove conflicting scopes; default loop unswitching improves WT and Bass.

experiments.name: wt-direct-envelope
experiments.reason: Removing table-pair cache regresses WT mean/max.

experiments.name: res-ordered-clamp
experiments.reason: Ordered clamping improves Snare target mean/max.

experiments.name: wt-direct-frequency
experiments.reason: Exact EMAC conversion is cheaper than cache-key testing on target.

experiments.name: res-fixed-decay
experiments.reason: Fixed-point recurrence reuse improves Snare mean/max; countdown crossing remains original path.

experiments.name: wt-unused-envelope
experiments.reason: Extracted helper is outlined; WT mean increases to 10299 cycles.

experiments.name: wt-unused-envelope-inline
experiments.reason: Forcing inlining restores throughput but mean/max still regress versus selected path.

experiments.name: bass-fixed-pitch
experiments.reason: Bass mean increases despite a smaller maximum; no sustained overall win.

experiments.name: wt-frequency-lut
experiments.reason: 16 KiB table increases WT mean and maximum versus EMAC.

experiments.name: wt-frequency-exact32
experiments.reason: Exact 32-bit algebra passes stream but extra sign/shift/multiply work regresses target throughput.

initial_full_ISR_comparison.measurement: executed ISR observer, emulated ColdFire at 264 MHz
initial_full_ISR_comparison.limits: Not silicon timing; no comparison against the unmatched physical capture.

remaining: Finish all active final qualification runs; do not replace sustained frames with shorter screening runs.

Commit/push verified source/tests; package only after all applicable safety gates pass.

exact.stream_encoding: action u8 then all five state byte arrays, each control field, RNG, PCM and status; numeric fields LE; ABI padding excluded

edge_binding.basis: Final target.bin is byte-identical to the selected target on which extended edges executed.

readiness_repair.observed: Repeated boot init erased 199191 nonzero PCM bytes but left loaded .data cookie READY.
readiness_repair.repair: Invalidate PCM and runtime cookies before the complete BSS scrub; decode and publish readiness afterward.
readiness_repair.scope: Repeated pre-RTOS initializer; no physical first-boot hang attribution.

committed_source_binding.scope: The image was built before the implementation commit; all 26 compiled-manifest source files are byte-identical to that commit.

implementation_plateau.assessment: Measured practical plateau after the recorded target experiments; integration qualification remains pending.
basis: Primitive-call regression dominates and is removed.
Independent recurrence fixed points improve decay work without skipping transitions.
Further cache removal, unused-envelope splitting, NT compiler, pitch-tail, lookup-table and integer formula experiments regress target mean or maxima.
Remaining resonator/oscillator/RNG recurrence steps determine following samples; no measured exact replacement is outstanding.
implementation_plateau.reopen_if: New matched physical per-algorithm profiles or a reproducible regression identify a substantial untested bottleneck.

repository_check.limits: Generic missing canary/CF-final outputs and OT_PROJECT cases are explicitly skipped; candidate codegen, original/reference, runtime, FX, audio and lifecycle checks run independently.

sustained_cutover.reason: Preserve the completed full-duration row and cover the other fourteen full-duration rows in two independent local processes; no shortened tests.

instrumentation_comparison.limits: Matched fixture and image, independent whole-ISR observer. Maxima may occur on different frames; this difference is not a constant per-frame timer overhead bound.

ACK_work_comparison.measurement: ACK-to-ACK CPU work, including intervening stock tasks; not ISR duration or interrupt latency
ACK_work_comparison.limits: Cannot be equated to the supplied physical ISR deadline-miss counter. Candidate ACK work peaks approach the whole frame period despite ISR maxima meeting the preferred ceiling.

ACK_work.scope: ACK-to-ACK CPU work including intervening tasks; not ISR latency

CF_disarmed_diagnostic.limits: Diagnostic comparison only; production CF remains armed. Silent CF input changes DSP/stock execution as well, so differences are not an invariant cost partition or a hardware bound.

baseline_recovery.initial_build_return: Failed after generating MAIN because the per-work baseline/reproduction fixture directory was absent. No invalid image was substituted.
baseline_recovery.repair: Ran the original DSP identity and memory verifiers against the existing pinned baseline/reproduction; source/image output files were not changed.
baseline_recovery.scope: Frozen pre-campaign binary and its actual placement; not a fresh hardware timing claim.

private_prewrap_audit.remaining: Actual package roundtrip/corruption and full PROBE_GATES.json, then run unchanged complete private qualification aggregator. No gate is waived.
